name: hud_ui_mgr_update_frame
description: HudUiMgr::UpdateFrame drives the per-frame HUD update, objective/timer branches, tracker and timed-task updates, container updates, floating timer sampling, reticle updates, and weapon-slot reset.
known_limits: Tier C only; no VC COFF byte-comparison target exists yet, so tier S remains open.

Current recoil_native_smoke compiles zhud_ui_tests.cpp with RECOIL_NATIVE_ZHUD_UI_LIFECYCLE_ONLY; the broader zhud_mgr_update_frame_smoke exists in the non-lifecycle branch and is not registered in the active native smoke binary.
functional_evidence: Binary Ninja HLIL at 0x410fe0 shows layout pre-update slot 3, disabled-HUD chat panel draws and fixed timer update, enabled-HUD objective StartHide gate, meter fill tick gate, HudSensorTracker::Update, zTimedTask active-list tick, current-layout update slot 0, HUD/top/chat/string-menu container updates, floating timer elapsed/frame accumulation and one-second sample reset, visible floating timer update, reticle update, 32 weapon slot SetVisible(0) pairs, and reset of sensor target count and weapon state.

The native HUD manager smoke verifies the disabled chat/timer branch, layout pre/update dispatch, enabled per-frame container path, zTimedTask expiry during the frame, floating timer one-second sample reset/display value, visible floating timer and reticle updates, 64 weapon-slot visibility resets, and final sensor/weapon counters reset.
